claim: Patchline ships a fully mechanized type-and-effect system for the migration DSL with progress and preservation proofs. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the type-and-effect claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make type-effect-system-gate`.
